experiment_data.hypothesis: CORAL ordinal regression with DNN backbone (19→64→32→CORAL) achieves comparable or superior 4-class accuracy to RF on all 9 atlas cells, while providing better ordinal consistency (monotonic predictions) and lower MAE due to ordinal-aware loss. Prior baseline_battery_9cell_001 showed RF≈CORAL with simple CORAL; DNN backbone may widen the gap. Algorithmic contribution: ordinal-specific classifier for depth estimation.
